# wikihow.life

> > wikihow.life is a practical how-to guide platform covering DIY home improvement, automotive maintenance, cooking, academic preparation, and specialized technical skills.

wikihow.life provides step-by-step instructional guides and community forums for a wide range of practical skills, from home and yard maintenance to academic test preparation and creative projects. The site combines detailed tutorials with community discussion to help users tackle everything from HVAC maintenance to culinary projects.

## Key Topics

- step-by-step guides
- DIY home improvement
- yard and landscape maintenance
- automotive maintenance
- HVAC systems
- welding and metalwork
- cooking and recipes
- academic preparation
- design and prototyping
- self-publishing
- meditation and wellness
- forum discussions
- troubleshooting
- home repair

## Home & Yard Maintenance

- [How to Color Mulch: Dye Faded Mulch to Look Brand New](https://www.wikihow.life/Special:Randomizer): Step-by-step guide to dyeing mulch with garden sprayer for yard landscaping
- [How to Replace Deck Railing with Prebuilt Vinyl Railing: 13 Steps](https://www.wikihow.life/Replace-Deck-Railing-with-Prebuilt-Vinyl-Railing): DIY home improvement guide for replacing deck railing with vinyl materials
- [How to Test a Lawn Mower Starter: 12 Steps (with Pictures)](https://www.wikihow.life/Test-a-Lawn-Mower-Starter): Step-by-step guide to testing and troubleshooting lawn mower starter issues
- [How to Clean a Trane Rooftop Unit (RTU) Condensing Coil: 12 Steps](https://www.wikihow.life/Clean-a-Trane-Rooftop-Unit-(RTU)-Condensing-Coil): HVAC maintenance guide for cleaning Trane rooftop unit condensing coils

## Technical Skills & Trades

- [How to Gas Tungsten Arc Weld an Aluminum Corner Joint](https://www.wikihow.life/Gas-Tungsten-Arc-Weld-an-Aluminum-Corner-Joint): Technical guide to GTAW welding techniques for aluminum corner joints
- [How to Prototype a Design (with Pictures) - wikiHow Life](https://www.wikihow.life/Prototype-a-Design): Design thinking guide for prototyping ideas and testing product concepts

## Cooking & Food Preparation

- [How to Build a Delicious Mezze Platter: 12 Steps (with Pictures)](https://www.wikihow.life/Build-a-Delicious-Mezze-Platter): Recipe guide for assembling Mediterranean mezze platters with hummus and dips
- [How to Make Homemade Dunkaroos Dip: 8 Steps - wikiHow Life](https://www.wikihow.life/Make-Homemade-Dunkaroos-Dip): Recipe for homemade Dunkaroos-style dessert dip with Funfetti ingredients

## Academic & Personal Development

- [How to Survive Taking an AP Test - wikiHow Life](https://www.wikihow.life/Survive-Taking-an-AP-Test): Student guide for Advanced Placement exam preparation and test-taking tips
- [How to Find the Extrema of a Function: 11 Steps - wikiHow Life](https://www.wikihow.life/Find-the-Extrema-of-a-Function): Calculus tutorial on finding function extrema using derivative tests
- [4 Ways to Move Deeply Into the Now Through Devotion - wikiHow Life](https://www.wikihow.life/Move-Deeply-Into-the-Now-Through-Devotion): Spiritual practice guide on devotional meditation and present-moment awareness

## Creative Projects & Publishing

- [How to Create a Cover for a Zine: 13 Steps (with Pictures)](https://www.wikihow.life/Create-a-Cover-for-a-Zine): Self-publishing guide for designing and creating zine covers
